description: The entire Phase-5 hardening deliverable and this Phase-6 convergence review's own output (verification/verification-report.md, security-report.md, purity-audit.md, proof-harnesses/*, fuzz-results/*, live-results/*, security-results/*, the contract's 'Post-Phase-5 addendum' section in contracts/sprint-1.md, and reviews/sprint-1/output/{verdict.json,criteria-evaluation.md,findings/FIND-001..003.json}) do not appear to be committed to git anywhere in this repository, based on direct inspection of git reflogs (not merely a Bash `git status` I could not run this session, but the plain-text .git/logs/refs files, which ARE authoritative for local commit history and readable without Bash). Evidence: (1) .git/refs/heads/main and .git/refs/heads/feature/self-improve-real-ledger-harden are byte-identical (both 51ec62f94453864cbd07e5ef2e4a068e2ae173f0); (2) .git/logs/refs/heads/feature/self-improve-real-ledger-harden contains exactly ONE line -- 'branch: Created from HEAD' -- meaning zero commits have ever been made on this branch since its creation; (3) grepping the full main reflog (.git/logs/refs/heads/main) for 'self-improve-real-ledger|verification-report|purity-audit|security-report|harden' returns matches only up to the merge commit 9804f75eddc8cd4ceb7d40d3e9f03303dc0455b5 (line 382, 'merge feature/self-improve-real-ledger'); the last feature-tagged commit before that is bd017daa96d71dfe781ccd2e6c7e69c72e4d86c7 ('impl review PASS iter2 (0 blocking, SAFE_TO_DEPLOY), phase 5') -- a PHASE TRANSITION commit, not a hardening-complete commit. No commit anywhere (main or the harden branch) mentions verification-report/security-report/purity-audit/hardening for this feature, unlike the sibling feature hl-realized-pnl, which DOES have a dedicated commit ('vcsdd(hl-realized-pnl): phase 5 hardening complete (30/30 proved...)', main reflog line 385) proving that pattern is normally followed on this repo. This strongly indicates the Phase-5/Phase-6 artifacts I read this session (and which iteration-1's own review, and this iteration-2 review, are entirely based on) exist only as uncommitted/untracked files in the current working tree, at risk of loss (checkout, stash, `git clean`, disk failure, or a concurrent agent operating in the same checkout), and in direct violation of this repo's own CLAUDE.md rule ('意味のある編集をしたら都度 git add -A && commit && push を実行する... 未コミット・未push状態のまま次の作業に進まない' -- commit and push after every meaningful edit, never proceed with uncommitted work).

evidence.snippet: 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000 51ec62f94453864cbd07e5ef2e4a068e2ae173f0 Example User <user@example.com> 1783639989 +0900	branch: Created from HEAD

notes: This does NOT indicate any code-correctness defect -- every source file this review re-verified (lib/ledger_reader.py, lib/gate_math.py, lib/promote_gate.py, lib/promote_gate_run.py, lib/promotion_history.py, lib/scope_guard.py, evaluator.py, and the test files) reads correctly and matches its documented behavior. The defect is purely evidentiary/procedural: the claim 'already deployed at merge commit 9804f75' and 'SAFE_TO_DEPLOY' in the existing criteria-evaluation.md rests on Phase-5/6 artifacts that this repo's own git history does not show as ever committed. Remediation is mechanical and low-risk: `git add -A && git commit -m "harden(self-improve-real-ledger): phase 5 hardening + phase 6 convergence artifacts" && git push` (or merge the harden branch's working-tree state back into main and push), from this exact checkout, BEFORE Phase 6 is marked 'complete' in state.json. Until that commit+push happens, this feature's Phase 5/6 evidence is not part of the repo's persistent, auditable history that VCSDD (and this project's own CLAUDE.md, '会話は揮発、file は不揮発') depends on.
